title: encrypt() panic documented in # Panics but function returns Result
description: smime-tree/src/encrypt.rs has a # Panics section in its doc comment. Like sign(), the function already returns Result<Vec<u8>, SmimeError>, so there is no reason for the documented panic to be a panic rather than an Err variant. What goes wrong: library callers cannot catch panics in normal Rust; a panic from inside encrypt() will unwind through their code. The fix is the same: replace every documented panic path with an Err return. This is distinct from the sign() issue because encrypt() panics on a different condition. File: smime-tree/src/encrypt.rs.
close_reason: The panic is in the rsa crate's encrypt() API which takes UnwrapErr(SysRng) — no try_encrypt variant exists. The preflight getrandom check (256 bytes) covers all practical failure scenarios. The residual TOCTOU gap is already documented in the # Panics section. Cannot fix without upstream rsa crate changes.
